title: Quick check: Chunking Strategies

questions.prompt: Which statement best describes fixed-size chunking in the context of chunking strategies?
options: Fixed-size chunking concerns how content is represented, selected, or ranked for relevance. questions.answer_key: Fixed-size chunking concerns how content is represented, selected, or ranked for relevance. Keep the source text and metadata traceable, measure retrieval with labeled queries, and verify that similarity scores correspond to useful results rather than assuming nearby vectors prove factual correctness.
questions.explanation: Fixed-size chunking concerns how content is represented, selected, or ranked for relevance. Keep the source text and metadata traceable, measure retrieval with labeled queries, and verify that similarity scores correspond to useful results rather than assuming nearby vectors prove factual correctness. This is why the lesson treats the concept as something to apply and verify, not as a guarantee of quality.

questions.prompt: Which practice gives the clearest evidence that overlapping chunks is working in chunking strategies?
options: Test only one easy input, then assume the behavior generalizes to every language, user, and data source.
Skip validation because a well-formatted answer implies the model followed the intended process.
Change the prompt, model, data, and settings at the same time, then attribute any difference to one cause.
Use representative cases, an explicit success criterion, and retained failure examples; compare results against a baseline before relying on the behavior.
questions.answer_key: Use representative cases, an explicit success criterion, and retained failure examples; compare results against a baseline before relying on the behavior.
questions.explanation: Overlapping chunks should be evaluated with evidence appropriate to its use. Representative tests and a baseline help reveal failures and avoid overstating what the example proves.

questions.prompt: A team applies fixed-size chunking from chunking strategies and gets a plausible result, but it has not checked an edge case. What should it do next?
options: Remove guardrails or access checks to make the next run more likely to succeed.
Increase model size and deploy immediately, without retaining a baseline or regression tests.
Reproduce the case with controlled input, check source/evidence and intermediate steps where available, test an edge case, and document remaining uncertainty.
Accept the result because confidence and fluency are reliable substitutes for measurement.
questions.answer_key: Reproduce the case with controlled input, check source/evidence and intermediate steps where available, test an edge case, and document remaining uncertainty.
questions.explanation: A plausible answer is not proof. Controlled tests, evidence checks, and explicit uncertainty help identify incorrect assumptions and unsafe failure modes.
